properties.name: Zenkutsu dachi
properties.note: Long forward stance, front knee bent over the foot, back leg straight.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Kokutsu dachi
properties.note: Most of the weight on the back leg; used with knife-hand blocks.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Kiba dachi
properties.note: Wide straddle stance, knees pushed out; the stance of the Tekki kata.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Gedan barai
properties.note: Sweeping block to the lower level; opens Heian Shodan.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Age uke
properties.note: Upward block that protects the head.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Uchi uke
properties.note: Middle-level block from the inside outwards.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Shuto uke
properties.note: Open-hand block, usually in back stance.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Oi zuki
properties.note: Punch with the hand on the side of the stepping leg.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Gyaku zuki
properties.note: Punch with the hand opposite the front leg, driven by the hips.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Nukite
properties.note: Straight thrust with the fingertips.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Empi uchi
properties.note: Strike with the elbow; strong in Heian Sandan and Yondan.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Mae geri
properties.note: Snap or thrust kick straight forward with the ball of the foot.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Yoko geri keage
properties.note: Snapping side kick; in Heian Nidan with a back-fist strike.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo

properties.name: Hiza geri
properties.note: Strike with the knee; in Heian Yondan.
properties.source: JKA syllabus of the Columbia University JKA club (columbia.edu/cu/jka); grading syllabi differ by organisation and dojo
